text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
* The European Commission has approved the release of 40 billion escudos to be invested in the development of the area surrounding Alqueva, a hydroelectric dam being built in southern Portugal.
* After meeting Planning Minister Joao Cravinho, pilots of state airline TAP-Air Portugal decided to suspend their strike for five days to give time to reach a deal with the company on working hours.
* President Jorge Sampaio will meet Nelson Mandela tomorrow in Pretoria for talks on the disputed territory of East Timor.
* Senior managers of struggling TAP-Air Portugal have accused pilots who suspended a strike over working hours of trying to destroy the state carrier.
* The dollar hits the highest level against the escudo in 13 years.
